parsed.title: Inconsistent validator for AC7
parsed.detail: The validator for AC7 uses `grep -c "unit-route"` on a specific list of 14 files, but the `Scope` section (lines 85-105) and the `Planning evidence` (PE-007) claim the census includes 'eight skill files and six tutorial files'. The validator in AC7 only checks 8 skill files and 6 tutorial files, which matches the count, but the `grep` command in the validator does not actually verify the 'no converged surface sends a replan row to the executor or the fold' part of the requirement, only the presence of the string.

parsed.title: Inconsistent sensor line numbers
parsed.detail: The progress log (cycle 1) claims `grep -n suggested scripts/workflow-status.mjs` returns only `:729`, but the actual code (as verified in cycle 2 and cycle 3) shows the line is `:735`. While cycle 2/3 correct this, the cycle 1 entry contains a discrepancy between its claim and the actual code state.
